# package ocppj

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-ocpp/ocppj"
```

Package ocppj is the OCPP-J RPC frame codec: the JSON arrays that carry OCPP messages over WebSocket. It performs no I/O.

Frames (OCPP-J 1.6 §4; OCPP 2.0.1 and 2.1 Part 4 §4):

	CALL             [2, "<id>", "<action>", {payload}]
	CALLRESULT       [3, "<id>", {payload}]
	CALLERROR        [4, "<id>", "<code>", "<description>", {details}]
	CALLRESULTERROR  [5, "<id>", "<code>", "<description>", {details}]  OCPP 2.1 only
	SEND             [6, "<id>", "<action>", {payload}]                 OCPP 2.1 only

Payloads stay json.RawMessage here. Typed decoding and validation belong to the version packages.

## Constants

```go
const DefaultMaxFrameSize = 64 << 10
```

DefaultMaxFrameSize is the frame size limit when Limits.MaxFrameSize is zero. The specifications set no limit; this is an implementation choice (ARCHITECTURE.md), large enough for the largest standard messages.

```go
const MaxMessageIDLength = 36
```

MaxMessageIDLength is the maximum length of a message ID, in characters (OCPP-J 1.6 §4.1.3; OCPP 2.x Part 4 §4.1.4).

## Variables

```go
var ErrMalformed = errors.New("ocppj: malformed frame")
```

ErrMalformed is wrapped by every Decode error.

## Functions

### func Encode

```go
func Encode(f Frame) ([]byte, error)
```

Encode writes f as a frame. Nil payloads and details are written as {}. It checks what Decode would reject for any version, except that the version-dependent checks (message type, error code) are left to the caller.

### func ErrorCodes

```go
func ErrorCodes(v ocpp.Version) []ocpp.ErrorCode
```

ErrorCodes returns the CALLERROR error codes version v defines (OCPP-J 1.6 §4.2.3; OCPP 2.0.1 and 2.1 Part 4 §4.3).

### func FormatErrorCode

```go
func FormatErrorCode(v ocpp.Version) ocpp.ErrorCode
```

FormatErrorCode returns the code for a payload that is not valid JSON or does not have the structure its action defines: FormationViolation in OCPP 1.6 and FormatViolation in 2.x.

### func OccurrenceErrorCode

```go
func OccurrenceErrorCode(v ocpp.Version) ocpp.ErrorCode
```

OccurrenceErrorCode returns the code for a missing required field or a wrong number of array elements, spelt as version v spells it.

### func RPCErrorCode

```go
func RPCErrorCode(v ocpp.Version) ocpp.ErrorCode
```

RPCErrorCode returns the code for a CALL whose frame is not a valid RPC request although its message ID could be read: RpcFrameworkError in OCPP 2.x. OCPP 1.6 has no such code; FormationViolation is used, the closest 1.6 code (an implementation choice, see ARCHITECTURE.md).

### func ValidErrorCode

```go
func ValidErrorCode(v ocpp.Version, code ocpp.ErrorCode) bool
```

ValidErrorCode reports whether version v defines code.

## Types

### type DecodeError

```go
type DecodeError struct {
	// Type is the message type, if it was read; zero otherwise.
	Type MessageType
	// ID is the message ID, if it was read. IDKnown distinguishes an empty
	// ID from one that could not be read.
	ID      string
	IDKnown bool
	// UnknownType is true when the frame's message type is not one the
	// version allows (see Allowed).
	UnknownType bool
	// Reason describes the violation.
	Reason string
}
```

DecodeError is the error Decode returns. It says how far decoding got, so that the engine can decide whether the frame can be answered.

### type Frame

```go
type Frame struct {
	Type MessageType
	ID   string

	// Action is set for Call and Send.
	Action string
	// Payload is the JSON object of a Call, CallResult or Send.
	Payload json.RawMessage

	// ErrorCode, Description and Details are set for CallError and
	// CallResultError. Details is a JSON object.
	ErrorCode   ocpp.ErrorCode
	Description string
	Details     json.RawMessage
}
```

Frame is one decoded OCPP-J frame. Which fields are set depends on Type.

#### func Decode

```go
func Decode(data []byte, v ocpp.Version, l Limits) (Frame, error)
```

Decode parses one frame received on a connection of version v.

It is strict: the frame must be a JSON array with exactly the elements its type defines, the message type a JSON integer the version allows, the message ID a string of at most MaxMessageIDLength characters, payloads and error details JSON objects, and nothing may follow the array.

### type Limits

```go
type Limits struct {
	// MaxFrameSize is the maximum size of a frame in bytes, checked before
	// parsing. Zero means DefaultMaxFrameSize.
	MaxFrameSize int
}
```

Limits bound what Decode accepts.

### type MessageType

```go
type MessageType uint8
```

MessageType is the first element of a frame.

```go
const (
	Call            MessageType = 2
	CallResult      MessageType = 3
	CallError       MessageType = 4
	CallResultError MessageType = 5 // OCPP 2.1 only
	Send            MessageType = 6 // OCPP 2.1 only
)
```

The message types.

#### func (MessageType) Allowed

```go
func (t MessageType) Allowed(v ocpp.Version) bool
```

Allowed reports whether frames of type t may be exchanged under OCPP version v. Types 5 and 6 exist in OCPP 2.1 only.

#### func (MessageType) String

```go
func (t MessageType) String() string
```

String returns the name the specifications use, e.g. "CALLRESULT".
